text: Plan correction recorded: preserve exact affine factors while making only forward residual maps authoritative; freeze support and reliability during CC differentiation; keep evaluation masks and labels out of optimization; treat inverse error as repair/export quality rather than an anatomical rejection; and omit a true-CC 3x3 lane until a valid residual factorization exists. Gates G0-G6 are dependency-linked so metric, sampling, controller, topology, capture, accuracy, and speed failures remain independently diagnosable.
